info.title: SAIA EDI Universal API
info.description: Saia LTL Freight XML API integration for shipment lookup, pickup scheduling, and bill-of-lading workflows using Saia Developer Portal API-key authentication.

post.description: Creates a bill of lading in SAIA EDI.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

PrintRates.description: Print rates flag: Y or N.

VICS.description: VICS standard bill of lading flag: Y or N.

Shipper.description: Shipper object containing ContactName, Address1, City, State, and Zipcode.

Consignee.description: Consignee object containing ContactName, Address1, City, State, and Zipcode.

Details.description: Details object containing one or more DetailItem commodity entries.

Barcode.description: Barcode value or payload when returned.

CheckDigit.description: Check digit for the returned PRO number.

Code.description: Saia error code; blank indicates no documented error.

Element.description: Element associated with an error when available.

PDF.description: PDF document payload or URL when returned.

ProNumber.description: Created bill-of-lading PRO number when returned.

TestMode.description: Y or N test-mode flag echoed by Saia.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.
